89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP education, excise and youth:
1. Satya Kumar Yadav is the State Project Director of Samagra Shiksha in Andhra Pradesh associated with the Personalised Adaptive Learning programme.
2. Annamayya district was declared illicit liquor-free on 2 September 2025 under Navodayam 2.0.
3. 'Passport to Earning', introduced under the Andhra Pradesh–UNICEF MoU, is meant for youth aged 15–29.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: B. Srinivasa Rao is the State Project Director; Satya Kumar Yadav is the Health Minister.
Statement 2: Correct: Annamayya was declared illicit liquor-free under Navodayam 2.0, with DRDA support for rehabilitation.
Statement 3: Correct: Passport to Earning is for youth aged 15–29, not 18–25.

89.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025 is incorrect?
o: Applications are to be submitted online within 120 days of notification.
The initial fee is ₹10,000 per application.
The Capital City Area of APCRDA is included under the scheme.
The penalisation charge is ₹40–₹400 per square foot.
89.x: The incorrect statement is that the Capital City Area of APCRDA is included; it is specifically excluded from BPS 2025. The other statements correctly state the online 120-day window, the ₹10,000 initial fee and the ₹40–₹400 per-square-foot penalisation charge.
89.tq: Negative / Incorrect Statement · tests the “Scheme provisions and exclusions” angle
n: ⚠ Capital City Area of APCRDA is excluded [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
Application: online; window 120 days from notification [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
Charge: Initial fee; Amount: ₹10,000 per application [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
Charge: Penalisation; Amount: ₹40–₹400 per sq ft [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
xs: The incorrect statement is that the **Capital City Area of APCRDA** is included — ⚠ it is **excluded** — so option **(3)** is correct.
Options 1, 2 and 4 are right: online within **120 days**; fee **₹10,000**; penalisation **₹40–₹400 per sq ft**.
xa: Notified via **G.O. Ms. 225** (**MA&UD**).
Regularises constructions from **1 January 1985** to **31 August 2025**.
Concession: **25%** for pre-**1997** buildings; **50%** for residential buildings in notified **slums**.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP building, power and zoning rules:
1. Andhra Pradesh's Building Penalisation Scheme 2025 regularises unauthorised constructions made up to 31 March 2025.
2. Small traders are not among the beneficiary groups under the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme.
3. Andhra Pradesh's Common Zoning Regulations 2025 reorganise 16 land-use categories into 9 zones.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: BPS 2025, which replaces the 2019 scheme, covers constructions up to 31 August 2025.
Statement 2: Incorrect: the programme's beneficiaries include farming families, small traders and small industries, but not large industries.
Statement 3: Correct: CZR 2025, the first uniform zoning framework for all ULBs and UDAs, reduces 16 categories to 9 zones.

89.s:
Arrange the following attacks associated with Madvi Hidma in chronological order: 1. Minpa–Burkapal ambushes
2. Jhiram Ghati attack
3. Dantewada (Tadmetla) attack
4. Sukma/Burkapal attack
89.x: The correct order is Dantewada (Tadmetla) in 2010, Jhiram Ghati in 2013, Sukma/Burkapal in 2017 and Minpa–Burkapal in 2020. The other sequences disturb this chronology.
89.tq: Chronological Ordering · tests the “Chronology of major attacks” angle
n: Year: 2010; Attack: Dantewada (Tadmetla) — ~76 CRPF killed [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
Year: 2013; Attack: Jhiram Ghati — Congress leaders killed [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
Year: 2017; Attack: Sukma / Burkapal — 26 CRPF killed [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
Year: 2020; Attack: Minpa–Burkapal ambushes [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
xs: Order: **Dantewada (2010)** → **Jhiram Ghati (2013)** → **Sukma/Burkapal (2017)** → **Minpa–Burkapal (2020)** — **3-2-4-1**, option **(4)**.
**Dantewada (Tadmetla)** — ~**76 CRPF** killed; **Sukma/Burkapal** — **26 CRPF** killed.
xa: **2021** — **Tekulgudem–Pedagelur**: **22** security personnel killed.
**Jhiram Ghati** (**2013**) killed **Congress leaders**.
Hidma was linked to ~**26** major attacks.

89.s:
With reference to exclusions under Andhra Pradesh's BPS 2025, consider the following:
1. Constructions on public land are excluded.
2. New constructions made after 31 August 2025 are excluded.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
89.x: Both are correct: BPS 2025 excludes constructions on public land and those made after 31 August 2025.
n: Excluded: public land, environmentally restricted zones, disputed ownership, new constructions after 31 Aug 2025 [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
xa: ⚠ The **Capital City Area of APCRDA** is also excluded.
Covers **APCRDA, VMRDA, VK–PCPIR UDA, IALAs**.
**VMRDA** = Visakhapatnam Metropolitan Region Development Authority.

89.s:
With reference to the proposed APPSC Group-I reforms, consider the following:
1. They include a simplified syllabus and a mandatory Computer Proficiency Test.
2. The validity of the Computer Proficiency Test is proposed to be one year.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
89.x: The reforms include a simplified syllabus and mandatory CPT; the proposed CPT validity is two years, not one.
n: Group-I: simplified syllabus; mandatory Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) [October 2025 · APPSC proposes recruitment exam reforms]
CPT: validity extended to two years; conducted internally by APPSC (no external agencies) [October 2025 · APPSC proposes recruitment exam reforms]
xa: Proposed by outgoing APPSC Chairperson **A.R. Anuradha**.
CPT conducted **internally by APPSC**.
Upcoming exams **offline**; working with **IITs** for secure online infrastructure.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about laws, taxes and air quality:
1. The Supreme Court upheld sub-classification of Scheduled Castes by a 6:1 majority on 1 August 2024.
2. Under the AP Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Bill, 2025, commercial vehicles aged 7–12 years pay an annual green tax of ₹2,500.
3. According to the WHO 2021 update cited in the Air Quality Life Index 2025 context, the annual PM2.5 standard is 5 µg/m³.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: the Supreme Court upheld sub-classification by a 6:1 majority, not 7:1.
Statement 2: Incorrect: commercial vehicles aged 7–12 years pay ₹1,500 a year; ₹3,000 applies to vehicles over 12 years.
Statement 3: Correct: the WHO annual PM2.5 standard after the 2021 update is 5 µg/m³.

89.s:
With reference to the AP Building Penalisation Scheme, consider the following:
1. The earlier BPS 2019 covered constructions made from 1985 to 2019.
2. The amended scheme covers unauthorised constructions and deviations up to 31 August 2025.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
89.x: The amended BPS covers constructions up to 31 August 2025; BPS 2019 covered 1985 to 2018, not 2019.
n: Covers: unauthorised constructions and deviations up to 31 August 2025 [September 2025 · AP Building Penalisation Scheme amendment Bill]
Earlier BPS 2019: constructions 1985–2018; voluntary, low participation [September 2025 · AP Building Penalisation Scheme amendment Bill]
xa: ~**50,000** deviations and ~**10,000** additional floors on **UCIMS**.
Acts amended include **Municipal Corporations Act 1955** and **APCRDA Act 2014**.
Sought by **CREDAI**, **NAREDCO**, **CLESA**, **Vijayawada Municipal Corporation**.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's 2025 Bills:
1. Under the APSADA Act amendment, the licence validity for aquaculture farming activities is five years.
2. Along with longer daily working hours within rest and spread-over limits, the Factories (AP Amendment) Bill, 2025 provided safeguards for contract workers.
3. Ahead of the AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025, the Cabinet approved 11 new Bills for tabling.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: farming activities get five-year validity, while business operations get one year.
Statement 2: Incorrect: the Bill included safeguards for women working night shifts.
Statement 3: Incorrect: the Cabinet approved 13 new Bills, not 11.

89.s: With reference to recent Andhra Pradesh Cabinet decisions, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Building height – Residential limit raised from 15 m to 18 m
Green tax – ₹3,000 for tractors and ₹1,500 for trailers
AP Private Universities Act amendment – Mandatory joint degree certification introduced
Deepam-2 – 5 kg LPG users upgraded to 14.2 kg cylinders
89.x: Under Deepam-2, 5 kg LPG users were upgraded to 14.2 kg. The height limit rose from 18 m to 24 m, green tax is ₹1,500 for tractors and ₹3,000 for trailers, and joint degree certification was removed.
n: Decision: Building height; Detail: Residential limit raised 18 → 24 metres; regularisation of unauthorised constructions (ULBs, UDAs, APCRDA, excluding Capital Region) [September 2025 · AP Cabinet — Universal Health Policy (₹25 lakh per family) and other decisions]
Decision: Deepam-2; Detail: 5 kg LPG users upgrade to 14.2 kg — 23,912 families in 16 districts [September 2025 · AP Cabinet — Universal Health Policy (₹25 lakh per family) and other decisions]

Decision: Green tax (AP Motor Vehicles Taxation Amendment Bill 2025); Detail: ₹1,500 tractors; ₹3,000 trailers [September 2025 · AP Cabinet — Universal Health Policy (₹25 lakh per family) and other decisions]

Decision: AP Private Universities Act 2016 amendment; Detail: Mandatory joint degree certification removed [September 2025 · AP Cabinet — Universal Health Policy (₹25 lakh per family) and other decisions]
xa: Deepam-2 upgrade: **23,912** families in **16 districts**.
**Mangalagiri Gold Cluster** — **78-acre** Gem and Jewellery Park, **Atmakur**.
Stamp duty exemption for institutions allotted Amaravati land after **1 January 2025**.

89.s:
With reference to the Scheduled Caste sub-classification issue, consider the following:
1. The constitutional provisions involved are Articles 15–16.
2. The relevant Directive Principles are Articles 38, 39, 40 and 46.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
89.x: Both are wrong: the relevant Articles are 14–16, and the Directive Principles are 38, 39, 41 and 46.
n: Articles: 14–16; DPSPs 38, 39, 41, 46 [September 2025 · AP Assembly passes Bill for sub-classification of Scheduled Castes]
xa: One-Man Commission of **Rajiv Ranjan Mishra** (IAS retd.).
Ordinance promulgated **16 April 2025**.
SC reservation (central) **15%**.

89.s: Among Bills passed in the AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025, which pair (Bill – key provision) is correctly matched?
o: Factories (AP Amendment) Bill – Working conditions and registration
AP Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Bill – Longer daily working hours, with night-shift safeguards for women
AP Prevention of Begging (Amendment) Bill – Rehabilitation
AP State Commission for STs (Amendment) Bill – Working conditions and registration
89.x: The Begging Bill focused on rehabilitation; the Shops Bill on working conditions and registration, the Factories Bill on working hours and night-shift safeguards, and the ST Bill on strengthening the Commission.
n: Bill: AP Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Bill, 2025; Key point: Working conditions, registration [September 2025 · AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025 — Bills passed and withdrawn]
Bill: AP State Commission for Scheduled Tribes (Amendment) Bill, 2025; Key point: Strengthens ST Commission [September 2025 · AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025 — Bills passed and withdrawn]
Bill: AP Prevention of Begging (Amendment) Bill, 2025; Key point: Rehabilitation [September 2025 · AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025 — Bills passed and withdrawn]

Bill: Factories (AP Amendment) Bill, 2025; Key point: Longer daily working hours within rest/spread-over limits; safeguards for women in night shifts [September 2025 · AP Assembly Monsoon Session 2025 — Bills passed and withdrawn]
xa: **Vehicles Taxation** Bill: **7–12 yrs ₹1,500/yr**; **over 12 yrs ₹3,000/yr**.
Three **2019** labour Bills were withdrawn.
Cabinet approved **13** new Bills for tabling.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP schemes and development indicators:
1. Under Andhra Pradesh's Deepam scheme, beneficiaries get 1 free LPG cylinder a year.
2. At the District Collectors' Conference 2025 in Andhra Pradesh, cybercrime was reported to have risen by 16%.
3. The Aspirational Blocks Programme, launched on 7 January 2023, covers 500 underdeveloped blocks.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: Deepam provides 3 free LPG cylinders a year, not 1.
Statement 2: Correct: cybercrime rose by 16%, while overall crime fell by 4%.
Statement 3: Correct: the Prime Minister launched it for 500 underdeveloped blocks; its dashboard tracks 49 indicators.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about APSADA and MEPMA initiatives:
1. Under the APSADA Act amendment, old registrations can be endorsed on payment of the licence fee plus a late fee of 50%.
2. The three MoUs signed by MEPMA on 26 August 2025 were linked to the vision "Zero Poverty – P4".
3. MEPMA's MoUs with Self-Help Group partners were signed for urban Self-Help Groups.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: a 50% late fee plus the licence fee lets about 20% of farmers regularise old registrations.
Statement 2: Incorrect: the three MoUs were linked to the vision "One Family, One Entrepreneur".
Statement 3: Correct: the MoUs were signed with partners for urban Self-Help Groups, not rural ones.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP policing, taxes and P4:
1. In NTR district, the CCTV network installed since August 2023 helped solve over 80% of crimes.
2. The Puramithra app offers a 5% discount on advance tax for 2025–26.
3. Andhra Pradesh's P4 programme is linked with SDG 8 – Decent Work.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: more than 4,000 cameras linked to the Central Command Control Centre at Vijayawada helped solve over 80% of crimes.
Statement 2: Correct: the 5% advance-tax discount applies to 2025–26, not 2024–25.
Statement 3: Incorrect: P4 is linked with SDG 1, No Poverty.

89.s: With reference to police technology initiatives, which pair is correctly matched?
o: AsTram – Surveillance of gatherings and disaster zones
e-Deployment – AI allocation of police personnel
Drones – AI allocation of police personnel

n: Initiative: AsTram; Purpose: AI-based traffic management [June 2025 · NTR district — first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage]
Initiative: e-Deployment; Purpose: AI allocation of police personnel [June 2025 · NTR district — first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage]
Initiative: Suraksha; Purpose: safety initiative with digital tools [June 2025 · NTR district — first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage]
Initiative: Drones; Purpose: surveillance of gatherings, disaster zones [June 2025 · NTR district — first in AP with 100% CCTV coverage]

89.s:
Consider the following statements about education, districts and health cover:
1. SNDT Women's University, Mumbai is Asia's first women's university.
2. Kanigiri is a division of Annamayya district after the headquarters change.
3. Under APSES 2024–25, the total coverage can extend up to ₹25 lakh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: SNDT Women's University, Mumbai is Asia's first women's university.
Statement 2: Incorrect: Annamayya's divisions are Madanapalle, Pileru and Rayachoti; Kanigiri belongs to the Markapuram district reorganisation.
Statement 3: Correct: procedures are covered up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, with total coverage up to ₹25 lakh and no limit for cancer.

89.s:
Assertion (A): Madvi Hidma was killed in the Maredumilli encounter.
Reason (R): The Special Party team of the Alluri Sitharama Raju district police conducted the operation.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
89.x: Both statements are true, and the operation by the Special Party team of the Alluri Sitharama Raju district police explains how Madvi Hidma was killed. The encounter took place near Nellooru village in Maredumilli mandal.
n: Who: Madvi Hidma — top CPI (Maoist) commander, head of the Central Military Commission (CMC) [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]

Where: near Nellooru village, Maredumilli Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR) district, AP — near AP–Chhattisgarh–Telangana tri-junction (Karegutta hills area) [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
By: Special Party team of ASR district police [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
xs: **Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A** — so option **(1)** is correct.
**Madvi Hidma** was killed near **Nellooru** village, **Maredumilli Mandal**, **ASR district**.
The operation was by the **Special Party team** of **ASR district police**.
xa: Date: **18 November 2025**, **6–7 a.m.**
Also killed: wife **Madkam Raje (Rajakka)** and **four** other Maoists.
Site near the **AP–Chhattisgarh–Telangana** tri-junction (**Karegutta hills**).
Hidma headed the **Central Military Commission (CMC)** of **CPI (Maoist)**.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about Madvi Hidma and rural power:
1. The reward announced for Madvi Hidma, head of the Central Military Commission of CPI (Maoist), was ₹1 crore.
2. The Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme aims to provide rural areas with 24-hour three-phase power.
3. In the CPI (Maoist) Central Committee, Madvi Hidma was its youngest member from Chhattisgarh but not a tribal member.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: the reward for Hidma was ₹50 lakh.
Statement 2: Correct: the programme aims at 24-hour three-phase uninterrupted power for rural areas, not single-phase.
Statement 3: Incorrect: Madvi Hidma was the youngest and the only tribal Central Committee member from Bastar.

89.s:
With reference to the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme, consider the following:

Beneficiaries: **6,122** farming families, **2,288** small traders, **225** small industries.

Reason (R): Its target was to end Maoism by March 2025.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false

89.x: Assertion A is true: Operation Kagar was a Union-led, multi-state anti-Maoist offensive in 2025. Reason R is false because the target was to end Maoism by March 2026, not March 2025.
89.tq: Assertion-Reason · tests the “Operation Kagar objective” angle
n: Operation Kagar (2025): Union-led multi-state anti-Maoist offensive — target to end Maoism by March 2026 [November 2025 · Madvi Hidma killed in Maredumilli encounter]
xs: **A is true, R is false** — so option **(3)** is correct.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about Maoists and AP excise measures:
1. Basavaraju alias Nambala Keshava Rao, killed in May 2025, was the former General Secretary of CPI (Maoist).
2. The AP Excise Suraksha App to curb spurious liquor was launched by G.V.G. Ashok Kumar.
3. Under AP's Daily Liquor Genuineness Verification System (DLGVS), licensees are not personally responsible.

89.x:

89.s:
With reference to concessions under Andhra Pradesh's BPS 2025, consider the following:
1. Buildings constructed before 1997 receive a 50% concession.
2. Residential buildings in notified slums receive a 50% concession.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
89.x: Pre-1997 buildings get a 25% concession, not 50%; residential buildings in notified slums get 50%.
n: Charge: Concession; Amount: 25% for pre-1997 buildings; 50% for residential buildings in notified slums [November 2025 · Building Penalisation Scheme (BPS) 2025]
xa: Initial fee **₹10,000**; penalisation **₹40–₹400 per sq ft**.
Application window **120 days**.
Notified via **G.O. Ms. 225**.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP land use and excise reforms:
1. Change of Land Use (CLU) applications under the new SOP in Andhra Pradesh are processed through the Real-Time Governance Society (RTGS).
2. The AP Excise Suraksha App helps stop liquor sales through unauthorised belt shops by geo-tagging bottles to authorised shops.
3. Annamayya district was declared illicit liquor-free under Sankalpam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: CLU applications are processed through APDPMS 2.0 under the MA&UD Department; RTGS is a complementary system.
Statement 2: Correct: the app geo-tags bottles to authorised shops, helping stop belt shops.
Statement 3: Incorrect: Annamayya was declared illicit liquor-free under Navodayam 2.0, after 494 of 650 identified offenders were rehabilitated.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP farmer and fisheries initiatives:
1. Rythanna Meekosam was a farmer outreach programme in Andhra Pradesh to promote Panchasutra-based farming.
2. Under the linked initiatives of Rythanna Meekosam, Rythu Seva Kendras were associated with certified natural produce.
3. Under the AIC–Andhra Pradesh Grameena Bank MoU signed in Guntur, shrimp insurance products will be sold through APGB rural branches under a bancassurance model.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: Rythanna Meekosam promoted Panchasutra-based farming, with officials visiting every farming household.
Statement 2: Incorrect: Rythu Bazaars were identified for certified natural produce; Rythu Seva Kendras have a different role.
Statement 3: Correct: the MoU adopts a bancassurance model under which AIC's shrimp insurance is sold through APGB rural branches.

89.s: With reference to the Panchasutra principles of the Rythanna Meekosam programme, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Principle 3 – Food processing and value addition
Principle 4 – Water security and efficient water management
89.x: Principle 2 is demand-based cropping; Principle 1 is water security, Principle 3 agritech adoption and Principle 4 food processing and value addition.
n: No.: 1; Principle: Water security & efficient water management [November 2025 · Rythanna Meekosam — farmer outreach on Panchasutras]
No.: 2; Principle: Demand-based cropping [November 2025 · Rythanna Meekosam — farmer outreach on Panchasutras]
No.: 3; Principle: Agritech adoption (drones, sensors, soil testing) [November 2025 · Rythanna Meekosam — farmer outreach on Panchasutras]
No.: 4; Principle: Food processing & value addition [November 2025 · Rythanna Meekosam — farmer outreach on Panchasutras]
xa: Principle **5** — **Government support systems**.
Agritech covers **drones, sensors, soil testing**.
**Rythanna Meekosam:** **24–29 November 2025**.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about farm and fisheries support:
1. Under the 'Farmer Champions' initiative in SPSR Nellore district, 759 Farmer Champions are selected.
2. Under the AP Fisheries Department's 'Super GST – Super Savings' programme, GST on key fisheries items was reduced from 12% to 3%.
3. In Budget 2025–26, the customs duty on fish feed, shrimp feed and other aquaculture inputs was reduced.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: one lead farmer is chosen per panchayat across 722 gram panchayats in 37 mandals, giving 722 Farmer Champions.
Statement 2: Incorrect: GST on items such as marine products, processed fish, shrimp and aquaculture equipment was cut from 12% to 5%.
Statement 3: Correct: Budget 2025–26 reduced customs duty on fish and shrimp feed and other aquaculture inputs.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about shrimp insurance and farmer support:
1. Andhra Pradesh accounts for 30–35% of India's shrimp production.
2. Andhra Pradesh Grameena Bank, a Regional Rural Bank, is sponsored by Union Bank of India.
3. The 'Farmer Champions' initiative in SPSR Nellore district gives training, modern machinery, post-harvest techniques and CSR support.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
89.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: Andhra Pradesh's share of India's shrimp production is 35–40%, not 30–35%.
Statement 2: Correct: APGB is sponsored by Union Bank of India; the Agriculture Insurance Company of India was only its MoU partner.
Statement 3: Correct: Farmer Champions provides training, modern machinery, post-harvest techniques and CSR support.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP schemes and districts:
1. Under Andhra Pradesh's modified livestock insurance scheme (National Livestock Mission), the farmer pays 15% of the premium.
2. The headquarters of Annamayya district was moved from Rayachoti to Pileru.
3. Polam Pilustondi, launched in August 2014, was intended to provide post-matric fee reimbursement.

Statement 1: Correct: the farmer pays 15%; the remaining 85% is shared by the Centre and State in a 60:40 ratio.
Statement 2: Incorrect: the headquarters was shifted from Rayachoti to Madanapalle.
Statement 3: Incorrect: Polam Pilustondi was an awareness programme focused on profitable farming.

xa: Anuradha's tenure: **1,733** posts offline (**1,92,419** candidates).
**327** interviewed, **179** selected.
**31** policy proposals sent to government.

89.s:
Consider the following statements about AP welfare and social measures:
1. The PCPNDT Act, cited in the Karnataka–Andhra Pradesh decoy operation against female foeticide in Kurnool, was amended in 2003.
2. Under Deepam-2, Phase 3 proposed that the subsidy be paid directly to gas agencies.
3. From 1 June, urban SHG loans are to be processed only through MEPMA's MLCC app.

89.x:
Statement 1: Correct: the PCPNDT Act was amended in 2003, not 2021.
Statement 2: Incorrect: Phase 3 proposed crediting the subsidy in advance to beneficiaries' accounts.
Statement 3: Correct: all urban SHG loans, not rural ones, were to be processed through the MLCC app from 1 June.

To order closure of industries near Uppada
To relocate fishing villages away from the coast

**Kakinada District Collector** is **Member-Convener**.

102.s:
Consider the following statements about AI investments in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The latest version of LG's EXAONE large language model series is EXAONE 4.0.
2. The 30th CII Partnership Summit associated with the Andhra Pradesh–LG AI Research discussions was held in Amaravati on November 14–15, 2025.
3. Google's announced AI hub project in Andhra Pradesh involves an investment of $15 billion over five years in Visakhapatnam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
102.x:
Statement 1: Correct: EXAONE 1.0 was the first version of LG's LLM series and EXAONE 4.0 is the latest.
Statement 2: Incorrect: the CII Partnership Summit 2025 was held in Visakhapatnam, not Amaravati, on November 14–15.
Statement 3: Correct: Google's project involves a $15 billion investment over five years for an AI hub in Visakhapatnam.

102.s:
Assertion (A): Google’s Visakhapatnam AI hub is its largest investment in India.
Reason (R): The project is an AI data centre in Visakhapatnam.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
102.x: Both statements are true: the investment is described as Google’s largest investment in India, and the project is an AI data centre or AI hub in Visakhapatnam. However, its location and nature do not explain why it is the largest investment.
n: Investment: $15 billion over five years — ⚠ Google's largest investment in India [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
What: AI data centre / AI hub in Visakhapatnam [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
xs: **Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A** — option **(2)**.
A: the **$15 billion** project is **Google's largest investment in India**.
R: it is an **AI data centre** in **Visakhapatnam** — the nature of the project does not explain its size.
xa: It is the **largest AI hub outside the USA**, with a subsea-cable landing station.
**200** direct jobs.

102.s:
Consider the following statements about AP data-centre projects:
1. The implementing entity of Google's Visakhapatnam AI hub project is Raiden Infotech India, a Google subsidiary.
2. Andhra Pradesh is targeting 6,000 MW of data-centre capacity by 2030.
3. AdaniConneX's AI data centre project was approved in Andhra Pradesh with an investment of ₹87,520 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
102.x:
Statement 1: Correct: the implementing entity is Raiden Infotech India, a Google subsidiary; Airtel and Adani Group are partners.
Statement 2: Correct: the State targets 6,000 MW of data-centre capacity by 2030, with Sify Infinity's 550 MW expansion an anchor project.
Statement 3: Incorrect: Raiden Infotech India, not AdaniConneX, will build AI data centres with an investment of ₹87,520 crore.

102.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The JSW Industrial Park covers 1,166 acres in S. Kota mandal of Vizianagaram and is expected to create about 45,000 jobs.
2. The State Investment Promotion Board is a single-window clearance body chaired by the Chief Minister.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
102.x: Both are correct: the JSW park's area, location and job potential are as stated, and SIPB is a single-window body chaired by the CM.
n: Project: JSW Industrial Park; Detail: 1,166 acres, S. Kota mandal, Vizianagaram — ₹531 crore; ~45,000 jobs; MSME park [October 2025 · AP Cabinet clears ₹1.27 lakh crore SIPB projects]
SIPB: State Investment Promotion Board — single-window clearance, chaired by CM [October 2025 · AP Cabinet clears ₹1.27 lakh crore SIPB projects]
xa: JSW park investment: **₹531 crore**; it is an MSME park.
Tourism: four-star hotels in **Amaravati**; luxury resort at **Araku**.

102.s:

1. The CESL tender under the PM e-Drive for 10,900 e-buses across five metro clusters was described as India's largest solar power procurement.
2. CERT-In is included in the Cyber/resilience group of the Apex Data Centre Advisory Council.
3. Google's proposed AI hub project moved from Karnataka to Andhra Pradesh.

102.x:
Statement 1: Incorrect: the tender for 10,900 e-buses was described as India's largest e-bus procurement.
Statement 2: Correct: CERT-In is included in the Council's Cyber/resilience group.
Statement 3: Correct: the project moved from Karnataka to Andhra Pradesh, triggering a tussle described as competitive federalism.

o: Water – Supply at 25% of cost for 10 years
102.x: Water is supplied at 25% of cost for 10 years; power is free for 15 years, 480 acres are given at concessional rates and SGST is 100% reimbursed (₹2,245 crore).
n: Incentive: Power; Detail: 15 years free power [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
Incentive: Water; Detail: At 25% of cost for 10 years [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
Incentive: Land; Detail: 480 acres at concessional rates [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
Incentive: SGST; Detail: 100% reimbursement — ₹2,245 crore [October 2025 · Google's $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam]
xa: **$15 billion ≈ ₹1.25 lakh crore**.
The move from **Karnataka** to AP sparked a "**competitive federalism**" row.

102.s:
Arrange the following stages of the proposed Andhra Pradesh district reorganisation process in the correct order:
1. Cabinet approval
2. Draft
3. Gazette notification
4. Consultation
102.x: The process runs proposal, data collection, draft, consultation, Cabinet approval, gazette notification, implementation and review – so 2-4-1-3.
n: Process: proposal → data collection → draft → consultation → Cabinet approval → gazette notification → implementation → review [October 2025 · AP district reorganisation — 26 to 32 districts]
xa: Final Cabinet approval/notification expected **January 2026**.
**Six** new districts incl. **Palasa** and **Rajampet**.

102.s:
Consider the following statements about cyclones, e-buses and capacity building:
1. The India Meteorological Department maintains the list of names proposed by the WMO/ESCAP Panel on Tropical Cyclones.
2. Visakhapatnam was among the Andhra Pradesh cities identified for the first phase of the PM e-Bus Sewa programme.
3. In Mission Karmayogi, iGOT stands for Integrated Government Online Training.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
102.x:
Statement 1: Correct: the IMD maintains the list of cyclone names; the 13-member WMO/ESCAP Panel proposes the names.
Statement 2: Correct: the first-phase Andhra Pradesh cities were Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Nellore and Tirupati.
Statement 3: Correct: iGOT is the Integrated Government Online Training platform for capacity building of Central and State officials.

102.s:
Consider the following statements:

2. The National Policy on Electronics 2019 set a target of $400 billion by 2025.

n: Land: 12.56 acres at 75% subsidised cost [October 2025 · ₹765 crore ECMS support for Syrma SGS PCB plant at Naidupeta]
Related schemes: PLI (2020), EMC 2.0, DLI, Semicon India (2022); NPE 2019 — $400 billion target by 2025 [October 2025 · ₹765 crore ECMS support for Syrma SGS PCB plant at Naidupeta]
xa: Related schemes: **PLI (2020)**, **EMC 2.0**, **DLI**, **Semicon India (2022)**.
Expected **₹2,000 crore+** cumulative investment in three years.
